description: Iteration-4's FIND-1006 fix rewrote REQ-117 step 6 in `specs/behavioral-spec.md` (lines 2611-2649) to require `getCitizen(id)` return `{...registryCitizen, balanceUsd}` -- the FULL real citizen registry record spread, never a hand-enumerated literal shape -- and this review independently confirms that fix IS structurally sound in isolation (see verification evidence below: live execution reaches `status:active`, and an exhaustive grep of the ENTIRE call graph `executeLoanIssuanceAttempt` reaches -- `lending-orchestrator.mjs`, `lending-gate.mjs`, `_shared/lib/is-self-funded.mjs` -- confirms the ONLY citizen-object fields ever read anywhere are `wallet`/`wallet.evm`, `walletAddress.evm`, `fuel.provider`, `humanDependencies`, `coLocatedWithCoordinator`, and `balanceUsd`; every one of those except `balanceUsd` is genuinely present on the real registry record, confirmed by direct read of `~/anicca/skills/self/spawn/registry/citizens.seed.json` -- so 'spread the real record + merge balanceUsd' closes the defect class with zero remaining gap for THIS call graph). HOWEVER: `specs/verification-architecture.md` line 192 (PROP-117c) -- the SIBLING document this SAME manifest requires reviewing, and the document that will literally drive Phase 2a's construction of fixture-3's own test -- was NOT updated in this round's fix, and still reads: '...proving `wake-gate.mjs`'s own `getCitizen` closure (resolves FIND-1004, critical: MUST include a fresh `balanceUsd` field, fetched via the same `usdcBalance`/`fetchImpl` seam, not merely the bare `{id, wallet, walletAddress, coLocatedWithCoordinator}` shape) ... genuinely prevents BOTH the `TypeError` crash AND the silent missing-balance fail-closed refusal...' -- i.e. PROP-117c's OWN literal acceptance-criteria text still describes and requires EXACTLY the FIND-1004-era bare-enumerated-shape-plus-balanceUsd pattern (`{id, wallet, walletAddress, coLocatedWithCoordinator, balanceUsd}`), NOT the FIND-1006 full-record-spread fix. This review empirically built a `getCitizen` closure to PROP-117c's own literal specification (that exact five-field shape, nothing more) and confirmed it reproduces the IDENTICAL silent-refusal bug FIND-1006 was supposed to have closed: `{"status":"refused","reason":"not_self_funded"}` against PROP-117c's own fixture-3 scenario (both citizens otherwise fully qualifying, self-funded per their real registry records). This is not a stylistic/cosmetic staleness -- it is a live, exploitable, empirically-reproduced re-occurrence of the SAME defect class (FIND-1003 -> FIND-1004 -> FIND-1006 -> this), this time because the sweep that fixed `behavioral-spec.md` did not extend to `verification-architecture.md`'s own cross-reference to the identical `getCitizen` contract. Since PROP-117c is the artifact whose own acceptance-criteria wording Phase 2a's test-author will read to build fixture-3's own `getCitizen` stub, a test written faithfully to PROP-117c's CURRENT text would construct the exact broken fixture and could either (a) incorrectly pass if the test-author also independently guesses to add `fuel`/`humanDependencies` despite PROP-117c not naming them (lucky, not guaranteed), or (b) reproduce FIND-1006's own silent-refusal bug a fifth time, this time surfacing at Phase 2a/2b rather than being caught here.

evidence.snippet: `getCitizen(id)` SHALL return the REAL citizen registry record for `id` ... with a fresh `balanceUsd` field MERGED on top -- `{ ...registryCitizen, balanceUsd }` -- NEVER a hand-enumerated literal shape.

proving `wake-gate.mjs`'s own `getCitizen` closure (resolves FIND-1004, critical: MUST include a fresh `balanceUsd` field, fetched via the same `usdcBalance`/`fetchImpl` seam, not merely the bare `{id, wallet, walletAddress, coLocatedWithCoordinator}` shape) ... genuinely prevents BOTH the `TypeError: getCitizen is not a function` crash AND the silent missing-balance fail-closed refusal a naive implementation produces

{"id":"Franklin","wallet":{"solana":true},"walletAddress":{"solana":"8FpqdcCHqjqkVXR58eVJa53neXbJf9emXhvHhgeUPCV9"},"fuel":{"provider":"x402"},"humanDependencies":[],"homeDir":"/Users/anicca/.blockrun","coLocatedWithCoordinator":true} -- confirms the REAL registry schema genuinely carries wallet/walletAddress/fuel/humanDependencies/coLocatedWithCoordinator (everything the call graph needs except balanceUsd, which is never part of the registry itself)

evidence.location: fresh execution this review, real unmodified `~/anicca/skills/economy/lending/lib/lending-orchestrator.mjs`, getCitizen built from the FIND-1006 fix pattern (`{...registryCitizen, balanceUsd}`, registryCitizen matching the real citizens.seed.json schema, both fixture citizens self-funded/EVM-walleted/co-located, lender surplus $10, borrower broke $0.10)
evidence.description: `executeLoanIssuanceAttempt({lenderId:'lenderA', borrowerId:'borrowerB', nowMs}, {getCitizen, gojoLogRows:[], ledgerFile, lockStatePath, disburse: stub})` returned `{"status":"active","loanId":"loan_lenderA_1"}` -- confirms the FIND-1006 fix, as ACTUALLY WORDED in behavioral-spec.md, is genuinely sound with zero missing-field refusal.

evidence.location: fresh execution this review, SAME real orchestrator, SAME fixture roles/balances, but getCitizen built from PROP-117c's OWN literal current text -- `{id, wallet, walletAddress, coLocatedWithCoordinator, balanceUsd}`, no `fuel`, no `humanDependencies`
evidence.description: Returned `{"status":"refused","reason":"not_self_funded"}` -- an exact reproduction of FIND-1006's own originally-identified silent, permanent, exit-0 refusal, proving PROP-117c's own current wording is not merely out of date but actively describes a broken construction for the SAME fixture-3 scenario it is supposed to validate.

recommendation: In the SAME Phase 1a pass that addresses this finding, rewrite verification-architecture.md's PROP-117c parenthetical (line 192) to match behavioral-spec.md's own corrected REQ-117 step-6 text exactly: replace '(resolves FIND-1004, critical: MUST include a fresh `balanceUsd` field ... not merely the bare `{id, wallet, walletAddress, coLocatedWithCoordinator}` shape)' with language stating the fixture-3 test's own `getCitizen` stub SHALL be built by spreading a REALISTIC, fully-populated citizen record matching the real registry schema (id/wallet/walletAddress/fuel/humanDependencies/coLocatedWithCoordinator) plus a stubbed `balanceUsd` -- i.e. PROP-117c's own text must reference the SAME `{...registryCitizen, balanceUsd}` discipline REQ-117 step 6 now states, NEVER re-describe or re-enumerate a bare field subset of its own. Additionally, as a process fix (not merely a text fix): any FUTURE correction to REQ-117's own getCitizen contract must, in the SAME review-response pass, grep verification-architecture.md for every place that independently paraphrases or re-enumerates that SAME contract (PROP-117c is not necessarily the only one) and update all of them together -- this finding recurred specifically because a fix applied to one document was not swept across its sibling, exactly the kind of narrow, reactive, one-artifact-at-a-time correction the iteration-4 verdict already warned against, just manifesting in a different document this time instead of a different field.
